description: 1. The agent must discover and use the `mcporter` CLI (not direct API calls) with the syntax `mcporter call gitee <tool_name> [--param key=value]`. 2. Call `get_user_info` to identify the current user as `zhang_wei`. 3. Call `list_user_notifications` with `--param unread=true` to retrieve only unread notifications (4 items); the read notification 'Old resolved issue' must be excluded. 4. Parse the notification payloads to infer the two relevant repositories: `fintech-corp/payment-gateway` and `fintech-corp/fintech-core`. 5. Call `list_repo_pulls` for both repos with `state=open` and identify: PRs assigned/reviewed by zhang_wei (PR #87, #131 → Needs My Review) and zhang_wei's own PRs awaiting review (PR #134 → My PRs Awaiting Review). PR #85 is also zhang_wei's. 6. Call `list_repo_issues` for both repos and filter for issues assigned to zhang_wei: I7XK2 (P1, fintech-core), I9QP1 (P1, payment-gateway), I7WQ9 (P2, fintech-core). Issue I6KP5 is NOT assigned to zhang_wei and must be excluded. 7. Generate `daily_digest.md` following the exact SKILL.md template with emoji section headers (📅, 👤, 📬, 🔀, 📋), markdown tables for PRs and Issues, categorized notifications (@Mentions / PR Comments / Issue Updates), and a 'Today's Suggestions' section prioritizing the most urgent items.
